name: mealkit-choose-meals-invalid-1
why: week is not an ISO-8601 week, so billing and fulfilment would key different weeks

schema.title: Choose Meals
schema.description: The household locks its meals for a week before the cutoff: accepting the command fixes that week's recipes and releases the week for charging.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription the choice belongs to; minted by subscriptions when the household subscribed.

week.description: ISO-8601 week the box is delivered in, e.g. 2026-W36.

recipeIds.description: Recipe catalogue ids, one per meal in the week's box, in the order the household chose them; never empty in 1.0.
